desc: It seems over at the Japanese side, Nareko's design is compared to a "[**Hitoshi-kun Doll**](https://dic.pixiv.net/a/ひとし君人形)". This distinctive doll comes from a really long-running [**quiz show**](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/日立_世界・ふしぎ発見!) that... stopped airing just last year, actually (March 2024). In the show, these dolls are the point tokens of the game.
